footer.tagline: A short sentence that says what your product does and who it is for.

meta.title: App Boilerplate — Your tagline goes here
meta.description: Describe your product in one or two sentences. This text is used for search engines and link previews.

hero.title: A clear headline about the value you deliver.
hero.subtitle: One or two sentences that explain what your product does, who it is for, and why it is better than the alternative.
hero.note: Free to start. No credit card required.

features.title: Everything you need to launch.
features.lead: Replace these cards with the three benefits your customers care about most.

one.title: First benefit
one.body: Explain the outcome your customer gets, not the feature you built.

two.title: Second benefit
two.body: Keep it short and concrete. One sentence is usually enough.

three.title: Third benefit
three.body: Use the words your customers use when they describe the problem.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps.

one.title: Create an account
one.body: Sign up in under a minute with your email or a social account.

two.title: Set things up
two.body: Describe the one thing a new customer does first.

three.title: Get the result
three.body: Describe the moment your customer sees the value.

q1.question: What is this product?
q1.answer: Answer the first question a new visitor asks. Keep it to two or three sentences.

q2.question: How much does it cost?
q2.answer: Explain your pricing, or say when pricing will be announced.

q3.question: How do I get started?
q3.answer: Tell visitors exactly what to do next and what happens after they do it.

q4.question: How do I contact support?
q4.answer: Share the fastest way to reach you and how quickly you usually reply.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Tell visitors what happens when they click, then send them to your signup page or store listing.

meta.title: About App Boilerplate
meta.description: Why we are building this product, what we believe, and where we are headed.

hero.title: Tell your story here.
hero.subtitle: A short introduction to who you are and why this product exists.

story.title: Why we are building this.
story.p1: Describe the problem you noticed and who has it. Concrete details are more convincing than big claims.
story.p2: Explain how your product changes that, and what makes your approach different.

one.title: First value
one.body: A principle that guides how you build.

two.title: Second value
two.body: A promise you make to your customers.

three.title: Third value
three.body: Something you refuse to compromise on.
